features.title: Two bodies, one team
features.text: Share a life force with an eidolon while combining its martial abilities with your spellcasting. Eidolon choice determines your tradition and many of your options.

features.title: Act Together
features.text: Coordinate both bodies to gain an additional single action once per round. You share hit points and attack penalties, so protecting both positions and planning actions are essential.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4 → 3.5–4.5. Eidolon attacks plus spells combine offense; eidolon and spell choices shift emphasis.
ratings.defense: 3 → 2.5–4. Eidolon defenses vary, while the shared HP pool makes protecting both bodies important.
ratings.support: 3.5 → 2.5–4. Eidolon abilities, positioning and spell choices can emphasize party assistance.
ratings.utility: 3 → 3–4. Two bodies and an eidolon-dependent tradition provide varied exploration options.
ratings.difficulty: 4.5 → 4.5. Coordinate two positions, shared HP, attack penalties and Act Together.
